name: Low-Carb Turkey Enchilada Casserole

fit.notes: 538 cal (within 400-650) and 10.7 g carb (<=35) per serving on source; no seafood; budget ground-turkey bake; source 8 servings scales cleanly to 14 by weight.

dupe_check.evidence: Closest turkey neighbor crockpot-mexican-turkey-casserole shares protein+enchilada-sauce but is a rice+black-bean+corn+bell-pepper crockpot casserole, whereas this is a crustless LOW-CARB oven bake with no rice/beans/corn/tortilla (whole green chiles stand in for tortillas) - only 2 of 4 axes (protein, sauce) match, starch and method differ, so a distinct plate.
dupe_check.other_turkey_texmex_ruled_out: ground-turkey-enchilada-skillet-bowls (skillet rice+bean bowl, not casserole), turkey-taco-casserole (taco/salsa+tortillas+beans), loaded-ground-turkey-nacho-bake (salsa+chips), turkey-tamale-pie (grits/cornbread crust+corn), turkey-chile-relleno-casserole-skillet (rice skillet, broth-based).

cross_protein_collision_note: The source recipe explicitly offers ground beef as a swap, so this could collide with any low-carb crustless BEEF enchilada casserole another selector may hold; also structurally adjacent to chile-relleno-casserole-ground-beef (poblano+cheese) though that is an egg-custard rice bake. Decider should watch for a same-dish beef twin.
